description: This PHP source file defines a Drupal migration source plugin class 'MenuLink' for migrating menu link data from Drupal 6/7 databases. It includes methods for querying menu link data, defining fields, preparing rows, and handling translations, specifically for the 'menu_link_content' module.

classes.name: MenuLink
classes.description: A Drupal migration source plugin class for extracting menu link data from Drupal 6/7 databases.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Builds and returns a database query for retrieving menu link data, with conditions based on configuration.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Defines and returns the list of fields available in the source data, including dynamic fields based on database schema.

methods.name: prepareRow
methods.description: Prepares and modifies each data row before migration, handling language, translation, and description processing.

methods.name: hasTranslation
methods.description: Checks if a menu link identified by mlid has an i18n translation.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Returns the primary key definition for the source data, based on 'mlid'.
